meta.source: Measured from 11 Android screenshots (1080×2400 px, density 2.625). Lengths are dp written as px; radii and spacing are ±1dp.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand yellow. Primary button fill, selected option border, checked checkbox, active tab icon/label/indicator, field icons, links. As text: on `bg` 15.0:1, on `surface` 13.1:1.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` fill (button labels, checkbox tick). 13.1:1 on `primary`.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background on every screen, the splash and the outline button fill. Also the search card's inner fill.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Filled containers: text inputs, location/date fields, language options, list cards, avatar, back button, bottom navigation.

tokens.name: surface-toast
tokens.usage: Error toast background at the top of the screen. Captured mid-animation: confirm in code.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1dp outline on inputs, fields and the search card. 1.5:1 on `bg` — decorative edge only, never the sole way to show a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Unchecked checkbox outline and inactive page-indicator dots. On `surface` it measures 1.6:1 — below the 3:1 floor for a control edge; kept exact from the app, flag for a fix.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings, values, button labels on outline buttons, field values. 20.3:1 on `bg`, 17.7:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Placeholders, option subtitles, inactive tab labels and icons, hints on `surface` (7.0:1).

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Secondary copy directly on `bg`: onboarding body, screen subtitles, greeting, “Ver tudo” (7.3:1).

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: A sua próxima boleia já vai a caminho.
styles.usage: Welcome screen headline over the photo.

styles.name: app-bar
styles.usage: Top bar screen name; also the brand lockup word next to the pin.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Home section headers; the user's name in the greeting.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Encontre boleias interurbanas práticas em Angola.
styles.usage: Body copy, field values, placeholders, empty states, pill button label.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels above inputs; route names.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Small label above a value inside a location field.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between page-indicator dots.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Form label to its input.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Between stacked fields in the search card; section header to its content; icon to text inside fields (12–14).

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Inner padding of cards and fields.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Screen side margin on every screen; text inset inside inputs.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Between form groups (email → password).

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Between home sections.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text inputs, language options, list cards, form buttons (language, login, retry).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Fields inside the search card; onboarding and welcome buttons.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Toast.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Search card container; bottom navigation top corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Search button, page-indicator dots, avatar and round icon button.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and text inputs.

tokens.name: field-height
tokens.usage: Labelled location fields (De / Para).

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: Avatar circle in the home greeting.

tokens.name: icon-button
tokens.usage: Round back button.

tokens.name: checkbox
tokens.usage: Checkbox square.

tokens.name: flag
tokens.usage: Flag disc in a language option (includes its white ring).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons and toolbars (search, funnel).

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Field icons and the back arrow.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation and header icons.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Every outline: inputs, cards, outline button, selected option.
